purpose: Teach: 智子/秀夫/美香/花園/小人/夫君/姐/追い出し

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがご友人の智子さんとお茶されてたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was having tea with his friend Tomoko.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone. Gentle observation shared as if passing along a small detail. Relaxed pace, natural cadence of a mother sharing her day.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんのお友達の秀夫おじさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I met Dad's friend Uncle Hideo today.
lines.style: Bright, immediate engagement. Quick, eager to share. Small voice full of importance at being included in grown-up introductions. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「美香ちゃんが結婚されたわ」って語って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father mentioned that Mika got married.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful delivery. Slight pause before the news, as if turning something over. Gentle tone—sharing gossip but not unkindly. Soft trailing-off.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと近所の花園に散歩に行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I went for a walk in the neighborhood garden.
lines.style: Soft pride in the small outing. Deliberate pace, savoring the memory. Voice settles on each detail—the father, the walk, the garden. Genuine contentment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「白雪姫の小人たちの絵本を読んで下さる」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said he'd read you the Snow White picture book with the dwarves.
lines.style: Tender anticipation in the voice. Slight lift on the story title. Sharing something sweet he said, the kind of thing a mother notices he's planning for their child.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが智子さんを「夫君として支える」って仰ってたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad said he'd support Tomoko as her husband.
lines.style: Earnest, careful enunciation. Small voice trying to report something serious and grown-up. Slight uncertainty—repeating what was said without fully understanding, but wanting to get it right.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「姐さん、つまりお姉さんは頼れる人」と仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said your older sister is someone you can rely on.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured delivery. Words chosen with care. Slight emphasis on 'rely on'—the kind of thing a parent says that matters. Warm but serious.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと友達の追い出しコンパを企画したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I helped plan a going-away party for his friend.
lines.style: Bright finish, quick energy. Pride in being useful and included. Voice lifts at the end—excitement about the event and the responsibility given to him.
